title: src/config/egress.test.ts line 193 asserts maxCalls ["/s/broker"] for the L6 /s/max case

note: no usage window in the answer

question: Q-001
reason: Verified in the frozen test itself: the store entry for /s/max is 4096 a characters and /s/broker is the bt token (lines 37, 46); the reader pushes the requested path (line 52); the L6 env overrides the token file to /s/max (line 187); lines 192 and 193 then demand both that /s/max was read and that only /s/broker was read, which no implementation can satisfy. Test-plan.md L6 and the spec's scenario give no read list for L6, and the spec requires the token to come from its configured file, so ["/s/max"] is the only consistent expectation. The question is technical and the clarifier suggestion is exactly the one-line fix, so accept.

checked.claim: The L6 case points the broker token file variable at /s/max, not /s/broker.
The test demands the 4096-character token, which the store serves only for /s/max.
The next line demands that only /s/broker was read, contradicting the previous assertion.
The store maps /s/max to 4096 a characters plus a newline; /s/broker on line 37 holds the bt token instead.
The recording reader records exactly the path requested, so the recorded list reflects the file actually read.

checked.quote: | L6 | `BASE_ENV` with BROKER_TOKEN_FILE `/s/max` | loads; the token is 4096 characters |
checked.claim: Row L6 states only that the configuration loads with a 4096-character token and gives no expected read list.
